skills.name: Skewer
skills.description:
Summons four skewers within a 20m circle at the target area, dealing 1958 (1677 + 276% Healing Power) Magic Damage and Impaling enemies for 2.6s, preventing all actions. Skewers deal more damage where they overlap. When this skill levels up, it increases in both damage and cast time.
Deals +35% extra damage to monsters.
